systems.owner: Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education

GMB.note: Individual-level data integrated in the EMIS; no exchange between two systems or learner ID stated.

facts.fact: The document says Sierra Leone is integrating multiple data systems into a national data warehouse; the systems are not named.

SLE.note: As_of is the February 2025 exchange meeting; the document gives no other date.

facts.fact: The document says Eswatini's EMIS is driven by the Personal Identity Number, with individual-level learner and staff records, since national launch in March 2024 across all 976 primary and secondary schools; schools still submit PINs manually on claim forms for validation against Home Affairs records at regional offices, to be automated with SEMIS.
